Multipart uploads for the admin entry only: the route schema generator accepts a required request body whose only content type is multipart/form-data (no body schema, a multipart marker; other non-JSON shapes still fail generation); @fastify/multipart registered on the admin entry only (attachFieldsToBody false; files 1, fields 0, parts 1, fileSize = Fastify bodyLimit 1 MiB); readSingleUpload (exported from platform/index.ts only; platform/http/index.ts runtime exports unchanged) reads one part named file after the guard, bounds the whole body (Content-Length pre-check and counting for chunked) and stops reading on overflow; bad parts 400 / 20001 fields=[file], oversize 413 / 20001 fields=[body], envelopes without the file name or content; api / stream still answer 415. No contract change. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
